name: open-model-sdlc-kit
description: Open-model-first SDLC kit for a Go microservices workspace. A gated phase pipeline (spec → clarify → plan → tasks → implement → test → review → pr) over specialist subagents + skills + commands, wired to Serena (semantic code), Atlassian/Jira, and a curated MCP set. Tuned so a lightweight open model (GLM-5.1 / Qwen3-Coder-Next, pi.dev-style) writes high-quality code, and runs unchanged under Claude Code.
